answers.text_en: The day stem Bing sits in the Centre and is attached to palace 2. The actor is displaced: it has no directional position of its own and must operate through its host.
Palace 9 is the duty palace: it carries both the duty star Tian Ying (Hero) and the duty door Jing (Scenery). This is where the chart says the subject of the question actually sits.
